correctness.rationale: For the specified quadratic-residue tournament, all faces are subsets of the 19 translates v+Q. Independently enumerated all 2^19 masks and recovered exactly 8,247 faces and the dimension vector (19,171,969,2223,2394,1596,684,171,19), Euler consistent with S2 wedge 78 S3. Inspected the verifier’s complete matching (4,080 pairs; 8,246 nonempty faces; 40,014 incidences) and exact 4-by-81 signed Morse 3-to-2 matrix. Its all-column relation c0-2c1-c2+c3=0 bounds rank by three and a specified determinant -1 maximal minor makes rank three primitive, so the critical (one 0-cell, four 2-cells, 81 3-cells) CW complex reduces by integral cellular slides to S2 wedge 78 S3. The odd-order affine group forces the one-dimensional rational H2 representation trivial; independently recomputed all 171 group actions and complete signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces, exactly obtaining H3 character histogram {-3:38,0:114,2:18,78:1}, whose average is zero.
residual_risks: The 4-by-81 integral Morse gradient recurrence and determinant minor are inspected in source but were not separately executed in this run; independent enumeration/character checks do not alone prove the integral wedge.
Only the affine 171-element subgroup action on rational homology, not a full equivariant wedge splitting, is claimed.
